semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Techne specializes in measurement instruments that are crucial for moisture and oxygen management in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Techne Measurement Co., Ltd. manufactures precision measuring instruments, including dew point meters and oxygen analyzers, essential for controlling environmental conditions in semiconductor fabrication. Their products support moisture management and contamination control, which are critical for maintaining the integrity of semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Dew point meters capable of measuring down to -100 to +20 ℃dp
Online dew point measurement systems with automatic calibration
Oxygen concentration meters for monitoring flammable gases
Measurement solutions for humidity and temperature control
